description: This file defines the SizeOption interface, which provides methods related to specifying and representing the size of search results in a query context.

classes.name: SizeOption
classes.description: An interface for options that specify the number of search results to return, including methods to retrieve the size and its string representation.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the page size, i.e., the number of results requested.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the size option, formatted as 'size(<value>)'.
